* Embed agreed service-level agreements, operational KPIs, quality standards, and customer-experience measures into delivery. Use dashboards and performance reviews to monitor requisition aging, queue health, productivity, workload balance, process compliance, and delivery risk.
* Coach, empower, and performance-manage Recruitment Delivery Team Leads and their teams. Build capability through regular performance conversations, quality calibration, skills planning, cross-training, recognition, and succession and coverage planning.
* Maintain effective controls across all stages of recruitment. Promote consistent use of global standards, approved regional procedures and audit-ready evidence.
* Act as the primary service escalation point for SLA breaches, capacity constraints, aged requisitions, stakeholder concerns, candidate-experience failures, data-quality issues, and other delivery risks. * Build strong working relationships with regional Talent Acquisition leaders, Talent Acquisition Business Partners, hiring managers, recruiters, sourcing, TA Operations, HR, Global Mobility, mobilization, onboarding, background verification, analytics, technology, service excellence, risk, and compliance teams.
* Identify and drive process improvement opportunities to enhance quality, streamline workload, improve operational visibility and reduce rework across recruitment operations.
* Report regularly to the Senior director, People Hub / Shared Services on volume, capacity, SLA and KPI performance, quality, productivity, customer and candidate experience, compliance, risks, corrective actions, and improvement opportunities.

**About you**

* Experience leading process standardization, centralization, service transformation, or recruitment technology and automation initiatives is preferred.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

Version 1 is a values-driven, fast-paced organisation with ambitious plans for continued growth. Our Global HR Operations team plays a critical role in delivering consistent, efficient and people-focused HR services across the business, ensuring our core people processes provide a positive employee experience while supporting the needs of a growing international organisation. We are focused on continuously improving how we work, embracing AI, automation and digital solutions to simplify processes, reduce manual effort and deliver HR services more effectively at scale.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Administrator to join our team in Bengaluru. This is a varied operational role with a particular focus on HR data, systems administration and data quality, alongside supporting the wider day-to-day activities of the Global People Operations team. The role has a strong focus on data, systems and numerical accuracy, with much of the day-to-day work involving HR data management, reporting and system administration rather than traditional employee-facing HR support.

The successful candidate will work collaboratively across People Operations and the wider People Team, partnering with Employee Relations, People Partners and other People functions, as well as engaging directly with business stakeholders, managers and employees. The role will support employee data administration, HR system updates, bulk uploads, reporting and data requests, alongside HR tickets, employee queries and wider operational activities.

We are increasingly using AI, automation and technology to improve how People Operations services are delivered. The successful candidate will be comfortable adopting these tools as part of their day-to-day work and will be encouraged to identify opportunities to reduce repetitive administration, improve accuracy and enhance the employee and manager experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Data, Systems Administration & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date employee information across BambooHR, Enboarder, Greenline (Small Improvements) and our HR ticketing system, ensuring data quality and integrity and supporting accurate, efficient day-to-day HR processes.
* Process employee data changes and bulk uploads within agreed timelines, completing pre- and post-upload checks and maintaining appropriate records and audit trails.
* Carry out data-quality checks, cleansing and reconciliation, working with colleagues to resolve inaccurate, incomplete or inconsistent information and reporting discrepancies before they impact downstream processes.
* Assist with HR system changes, testing, integrations and data migration activities.
* Run standard reports and extract employee information to support regular and ad hoc data requests, recurring reporting and larger data exercises for the People Team, Senior Management and wider business.
* Review and validate data before sharing with stakeholders, ensuring the correct employee population, timeframe and agreed data definitions are applied.
* Escalate more complex analytical or reporting requirements to the appropriate team where required.

**HR Service Delivery, Ticket Management & Wider People Operations Support**

* Act as a first point of contact for Global People Operations queries, triaging tickets and resolving straightforward employee and manager requests or assigning them to the appropriate team, within agreed service expectations and with clear, accurate records.
* Support colleagues across People Operations, including with increased ticket volumes, flexing between activities as workloads and business priorities change.
* Identify recurring queries or administrative activities that could be simplified, standardised, automated or supported through AI.
* Provide day-to-day administrative support across Global People Operations, including employee lifecycle processes and preparing employee documentation, reports and HR records.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across Employee Relations, Payroll, HR Systems, People Analytics, HR People Partnering and other business functions.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when handling employee and business information.
* Support key People Operations projects and process-improvement initiatives, and develop and maintain clear, consistent, scalable and easy-to-follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for key workflows and processes.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Use AI, automation and digital tools appropriately to support day-to-day HR administration and service delivery.
* Identify repetitive or manual activities that could be simplified, standardised or automated.
* Support the development, testing and implementation of new People Operations automations and digital solutions.
* Help monitor existing automated processes and workflows, completing appropriate checks to ensure outputs remain accurate and reliable.
* Use AI to support administrative efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight, data security and confidentiality.
* Proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement, AI, automation and simplification across HR Operations.
* Support a culture of continuous improvement, challenging unnecessarily manual processes and looking for better ways of working.

  
**Qualifications**

**Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

* Excellent attention to detail with a strong focus on data accuracy.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills.
* Excellent Microsoft Excel capability and confidence working with employee data.
* Comfortable using HR systems, digital tools and learning new technology.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, tickets and competing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to identify inconsistencies and investigate when data or information does not appear correct.
* Comfortable working in a busy, high-volume operational environment.
* Proactive approach with a willingness to support different areas of the team as priorities change.
* Comfortable adopting AI and automation tools as part of day-to-day work.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive employee information.

**Desirable**

* Previous experience in HR Administration, People Operations or a Shared Services environment.
* Experience working with an HRIS such as BambooHR, Prismforce, Enboarder, Kantata, and/or Greenline Small Improvements
* 2+Years of Experience completing bulk data uploads or mass employee changes.
* Experience managing queries through an HR ticketing or case-management system.
* Experience producing and validating HR reports.
* Strong Excel capability, including experience with lookups, PivotTables, filters and data validation.
* Previous exposure to AI, workflow automation or process-improvement tools.
* An interest in HR technology and how it can improve People Operations service delivery.

**Personal Attributes**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Accurate – takes pride in getting the detail right.
* Proactive – takes ownership rather than waiting to be directed.
* Curious – questions information when something does not look right.
* Adaptable – comfortable moving between data, systems, tickets and broader HR administration.
* Improvement-focused – naturally looks for simpler and more efficient ways of working.
* Technology-minded – interested in how AI, automation and systems can improve HR processes.
* Collaborative – willing to support colleagues and contribute across the wider team.
* Reliable – capable of working independently and delivering to agreed deadlines.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Version 1?**

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

description:
#### **What is FranchiseBAZAR?**

FranchiseBAZAR is an Indian franchise marketplace that lists franchise, dealership and distributorship opportunities from 4,000+ brands. It has operated since 1998 and is based in Bangalore, with offices in Delhi, Mumbai and Frisco, Texas.

#### **How much does it cost to buy a franchise in India?**

Franchise investments on FranchiseBAZAR range from under ₹50,000 to above ₹10 crore. The investment covers the franchise fee paid to the brand plus the franchisee's own setup costs — premises, equipment, stock and working capital — which vary by industry and city. Each listing shows its own investment band.

#### **How do I become a franchise consultant in India?**

There is no statutory licence required to work as a franchise consultant in India. Most people come to it from financial services, real estate, insurance, accounting or general management. FranchiseBAZAR appoints branch partners who run a franchise consultancy in their own city under the FranchiseBAZAR brand, with training and systems provided.

#### **How does FranchiseBAZAR help a brand find franchisees?**

Brands list their opportunity free and it is shown to registered business buyers searching by industry, investment level and city. Brands that need the franchise system built first — agreements, operations manuals, recruitment — work with Sparkleminds, the consulting arm.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce India Professional Services partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest-priority growth markets.
  
  
**The Experience:**

As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior leader and a foremost expert in delivering business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully billable, high-impact role. You will be the Delivery Leader on strategic and complex customer engagements, and you will own the health, margin and outcomes of a multi-program portfolio.

You bring an India Financial Services background. You have delivered projects for banks, NBFCs, insurers and other FS clients, and you understand the domain and its regulatory context.

You are the strategic advisor and the point of accountability. You will drive platform adoption, demonstrate ROI, mitigate revenue and license attrition risk, and deliver agentic and generative AI programs on time, within budget and with quantifiable outcomes. You see risk before it lands and leave the portfolio and the team stronger than you found them. Keeping a project green is not enough.

  
  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing:**

* Program and portfolio governance: Own program governance, value-realization and recovery plans for strategic accounts, across multi-cloud and enterprise AI roadmaps in Indian FS (lending, onboarding, servicing, collections). Run the portfolio on live data, not static RAG status: margin variance, revenue, pipeline, billing milestones, bookings and delivered margin. Flag margin erosion and scope creep early.
* Executive stakeholder management: Work with C-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics and show measurable ROI. Lead Steering Committees and executive forums, and own executive-level escalations.
* Customer alignment: Challenge aggressive timelines and customer dependencies directly with the customer. Get their formal response recorded in the Delivery Review document.
* Risk, scope and compliance: Manage risks, dependencies and scope changes. Translate technical issues (AI compliance, data readiness, security boundaries) into business implications. Drive audits and written confirmations from PMs, architects and partner leads, with zero tolerance for issues such as unauthorized client-code pushes.
* Commercial and contract management: Support pre-sales in scoping and change management, and find expansion opportunities. Size the change-management and delivery effort for generative AI and digital agent rollouts. Define and oversee engagement models (T&M, Fixed Price) and keep delivery compliant with MSA/SOW terms.

Make sure staffing, DSR and SWE processes are followed, not just reminded. Keep delivery review canvases and status artifacts complete and current, without being chased.
* Cross-functional influence and expertise: Guide customer, partner (SI) and internal teams (MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs). Be a deep expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, custom development, integration and data migration.

The role keeps India employee data, hiring, onboarding, payroll inputs, and reporting accurate, secure, and aligned with Machinify's global People systems.

You will partner closely with the U.S.-based People Operations and People Systems teams, Finance, IT, Legal, and external payroll and benefits providers, in a high-ownership launch environment as the Bangalore team grows from its first hires to scale.

What You Will Own

**WORKDAY ADMINISTRATION & CONFIGURATION**

* Serve as the India subject matter expert for Workday HCM, partnering with the VP on the implementation and owning day-to-day administration, configuration, and support for the Bangalore workforce.
* Provide Workday and other systems support to the U.S. workforce alongside the existing U.S. team, including reporting requests, configurations, talent and performance review administration, and employee changes.

**INTEGRATIONS, DATA & REPORTING**

* Own data flows between Workday, the India payroll provider, benefits providers, and time tracking, running reconciliations and resolving exceptions each payroll cycle.
* Build People reporting and analytics (headcount, hiring funnel, time to fill, attrition, leave, compliance) and perform regular data-quality audits; document processes, controls, and runbooks.

**SECURITY, COMPLIANCE & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT**

* Apply role-based security and privacy controls in line with Machinify policies and Indian data protection and employment requirements, including the DPDP Act, and support audits and access reviews with Legal, Compliance, and IT.

**About AML** **RightSource**

We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.

**About the Position**

As a Director in our Financial Crime Compliance Managed Services group, you will be responsible for exercising leadership and strategic direction over client projects, while supporting the growth of AMLRS' business and people. The successful candidate should possess strong working knowledge and understanding of Anti-Money Laundering (“AML”) regulatory requirements and industry best practices to direct teams to produce high quality deliverables for clients on projects; as well as possess the ability to lead the development of new methodologies and approaches to address client needs.

The Director should understand and have the ability to work in an agile, dynamic environment and be able to exercise governance and oversight on multiple AML/financial crime projects.

This role requires collaboration with cross-jurisdictional teams and requires the ability to exercise sound judgment and AML knowledge to manage risk and ensure that product deliverables are executed with a high level of quality in within project timelines.

**Primary Responsibilities**

Provide operational soundness and compliance on AML/FC engagements:

* Lead financial crime engagements in accordance with terms of service agreements stipulated in the executed statement of work (SOW)/contract.

* Set the tone for quality standards and issue escalation and management on the engagement.

* Serve as a point of contact for issues escalated by the Manager and Senior Managers on the engagement and ensures prompt resolution of potential issues while managing client expectations.

* Define and review KPI/ KRI/ dashboard reports needed to effectively manage risks on the engagement.

* Define and review all pertinent client deliverables prior to submission to the client.

* Attend key client meetings and ensure that internal and external meetings are attended by the appropriate AMLRS team members.

* Oversee the engagement leverage model to ensure that it is continuously assessed and adequate to meet the needs of the client; as well as consider and escalate any contractual amendments required to maintain sound operation and execution of the engagement.

* Ensure that Senior Managers on the engagement exercise appropriate oversight and management over Time reporting by all members of the engagement team.

* Ensure that client billing is completed timely and correctly and approve invoices in a timely manner.

* Work with Senior Managers on the engagement to ensure that performance reviews are completed appropriately and timely.

Client Relationship Management:

* Leverage knowledge and experience to help identify new client opportunities (through client interaction and governance and oversight of the engagement team) and discuss with Account Management and Sales functions.

* Organize and lead periodic touch points with client stakeholders to assess their needs and obtain feedback around AMLRS performance, including organizing and leading bi-annual/annual executive meetings with the client key stakeholders.

* Manage and coordinate certain internal strategic initiatives across the Managed Services practice working closely with Sr Managers and Managers and providing updates to practice leads and rest of the organization as appropriate.

Mentor and coach Engagement Teams:

* Establish and set the tone for developing strong, inclusive mentoring and coaching relationships on the engagement, across all staff levels.

* Set the tone and encourage personal development on the engagement (i.e. encourage attendance of AMLRS trainings and personal development events and initiatives)

* Partner with Shared Service teams to address human capital and information technology related needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree

* Overall, 18- 22 years or more of AML / Financial Crimes experience, with an understanding of regulatory requirements as it pertains to areas such as transaction monitoring, AML policies and procedures, KYC, EDD and AML independent testing, and compliance transformation

* Proven ability to lead, mentor and coach teams of up to 200+ analysts.

* Very strong entrepreneurial spirit - highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities.
